problem_text:
A logistics manager needs to select packages for a delivery truck. Available packages are:
* Package A: size 26 cubic feet, revenue $56
* Package B: size 24 cubic feet, revenue $69
* Package C: size 3 cubic feet, revenue $21
* Package D: size 13 cubic feet, revenue $104
* Package E: size 46 cubic feet, revenue $73
* Package F: size 31 cubic feet, revenue $117
The truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this capacity. Each package is either fully accepted or rejected.
